name: Titan S2
driverConfig: 1 × dual-chamber dual-magnetic-circuit dynamic (high-rigidity dome + flexible suspension composite diaphragm)

materials.cable: 4-strand OCC + silver-plated OCC Litz with Q-Lock Mini modular plugs

pros: Excellent value with near-flagship accessory package
cons: Not the most technical or resolving at the price
Tuning is safe rather than exciting for some
insight: Titan S2 continues DUNU’s long-running Titan philosophy of honest sound, solid metal construction, and unusually good accessories for the price. The dual-chamber dual-magnet driver and Q-Lock Mini cable make it feel more premium than its $80 street price suggests. A practical and well-equipped daily driver.
